checks.name: insert select with expressions
checks.sql: INSERT INTO archive_orders (id, customer, total, status) SELECT id, customer, total, UPPER(status) FROM live_orders WHERE total >= 50 ORDER BY total / 10 DESC, id; SELECT id, customer, total, status FROM archive_orders ORDER BY total DESC, id;

checks.name: insert select without column list
checks.sql: INSERT INTO archive_orders SELECT id, customer, total, status FROM live_orders WHERE total < 50; SELECT id, customer, total, status FROM archive_orders ORDER BY id;

checks.name: insert select via cte
checks.sql: INSERT INTO archive_orders (id, customer, total, status) WITH staged AS (SELECT id, customer, total, UPPER(status) AS status FROM live_orders WHERE total >= 50) SELECT id, customer, total, status FROM staged ORDER BY id; SELECT id, customer, total, status FROM archive_orders ORDER BY id;

checks.name: insert grouped totals
checks.sql: INSERT INTO customer_totals (customer, total) SELECT customer, SUM(total) AS total FROM live_orders GROUP BY customer ORDER BY customer; SELECT customer, total FROM customer_totals ORDER BY customer;

checks.name: insert select mismatch
checks.sql: INSERT INTO customer_totals (customer, total) SELECT id, customer, total FROM live_orders;
checks.expected_error: INSERT ... SELECT source/target column count mismatch
